name: Blue Raz Dream Choice Chews | 200mg
description:
Get ready to chase the blues away with Choice Chew's Blue Raz Dream gummies! These sativa enhanced gummies harness the uplifting power of a sativa with that knock-out fruity flavor Choice Chews are known for. 

Made from scratch and infused with premium, high potency distillate, it's easy to see why these are a Michigan favorite!
